title: Human tasks checklist
summary: Manual gates for the learning loop, knob calibration, and promotion decisions. Automated weekday runs are listed for context — verify, do not duplicate. Cadence map: docs/ops/ops-review-cadence.md.

tasks.title: Review common PR check / merge fix-request reasons
tasks.summary: Run `ftse-project-traffic common-issues` (or read docs/data/pr_fix_occasions.json). Identify recurring CI or merge-conflict failure reasons from human and traffic-controller fix requests, then fix root causes (flakes, path guards, sync races) rather than one-off PR patches.

tasks.title: Review knob calibration priors
tasks.summary: Inspect knob_calibration_priors.json: ranking_mode, ready_for_shadow_bootstrap, bootstrap_priors, confidence, score_gap_vs_runner_up, and winner/loser catch rates.

tasks.title: Review unified experiment assessment
tasks.summary: Read experiment_assessment.json for continue/fail/recommend rows. After the 2026-09-03 human pass, task recommends should be empty: u4 and exit-shadow are watch, buffered-hold and IMB.L are done, scoring is on the engineering queue. Do not reopen cancelled N58/N59 knob rows. Drill into calibration_shadow_endurance.json for shadow detail.

tasks.title: Compare calibrated shadows vs primary AI judgment
tasks.summary: On Automation tab, compare forward marks for ai_judgment vs competing calibrated shadows before promoting any prior.

tasks.title: Promote knob priors only when gates pass
tasks.summary: Do not edit ai_judgment config until a shadow is surviving, ready_for_priors/score gap look sound, and confidence is acceptable. Survivors are starting priors for refinement — never auto-apply. Stress-book (3%) excess vs ^FTSE alone is not sufficient — see fair-cost gate.

tasks.title: Require fair-cost view before treating excess as deployable
tasks.summary: Keep 3% stress books as the defensive/churn lab. Before promoting knobs or calling primary 'beating the market', check ftse-trading-costs assess and/or fair-cost warm-start shadows. Promote only when fair excess beats ^FTSE and the fair rules control (or explicitly accept stress-only churn wins).

analysis.headline: Fair-cost Suite B lab
bullets: Require fair-cost view before treating 3% stress excess as deployable.

tasks.title: Review Suite B fair-cost lab vs stress Suite A
tasks.summary: Confirm ai_judgment_fair / rules_fair are marking under T212-shaped costs, endurance_zero_datum is set, and decision-review --suite B applies stay suite-local. Do not flip primary off 3% (N48) until B excess beats ^FTSE and fair rules control with a thick forward window.

analysis.headline: Fair-cost Suite B lab
bullets: Require fair-cost view before treating 3% stress excess as deployable.

tasks.title: Spawn Suite B twins only for recommend experiments
tasks.summary: If experiment_assessment has recommend calibration/exclusion/experimental tracks, dry-run then optionally apply ftse-trading-costs spawn-fair-twins (max 2). Never auto-fork every shadow (N53). Zero recommend rows is a no-op.

tasks.title: Review entry DCA cadence when overlay readiness fires
tasks.summary: Ack via CLI or Lifecycle Acknowledge (observe-only — Do not execute DCA from ack). Review docs/data/entry_dca_adoption_plan.json. When paper_execute_graduated is ready, Lifecycle Start enables 4× weekly entry DCA on graduated_allocation only. Do not change starter fraction or apply to primary/live while beat_market is false.

analysis.headline: Entry DCA adoption · —
bullets: Acknowledge is observe-only — use Lifecycle Start to execute.

tasks.title: Read analysis review synthesis
tasks.summary: After analysis-review (~10:35 UTC), read analysis_review.md for backward metrics, proposed experiments, ingest trials, and the observe-only buy-tier chart-outcome mix (well timed / giveback / no terrible).

tasks.title: Read buy-cross archive review
tasks.summary: After analysis-review, read buy_cross_archive_review.json: cross-book vs level comparison, week-0 cash, names that never entered because they stayed buy-tier. Observe-only — do not spawn a live cross book from sparse historic crossings.

tasks.title: Lock recording plan before new learning strands
tasks.summary: Before opening a new analysis, counterfactual, or model-dev strand, answer the four freeze questions (unit, freeze-at-t, join-later, never-backfill) and validate with ftse-decision-recording. Use preview-freeze for coverage gaps. Do not enable the Phase C freeze writer until readiness is READY.

tasks.title: Extend epoch-0 cron timezone map for new session
tasks.summary: When admitting a market with no MARKET_SESSION_DEFAULTS entry (or a timezone not in EPOCH0_WEEKDAY_SLOTS), add an explicit session + bucket mapping (e.g. tsx60	o America/Toronto	o US EDT/EST). Do not rely on the London DEFAULT_SESSION fallback. Then re-run euro-ingest-dispatch --sync-cron or import_cron_jobs for that key.

tasks.title: Verify decision packs before live capital
tasks.summary: For real-money trades, use decision-pack verify checklist and primary sources — separate from the automated learning loop.

tasks.title: Paper-learning review experiments
tasks.summary: When churn or exit-timing cohorts mature, run paper-learning review probes manually; do not auto-apply from shadow cohorts yet.

tasks.title: Override FCF auto policy only when majority/filing is wrong
tasks.summary: Ordinary buy-tier FCF mismatches auto-resolve (majority among screen/filing/company-adjusted, else filing-aligned OCF−CapEx). Write docs/data/research/<TICKER>/sources/fcf_bridge.json only as a residual override when that auto pick is wrong, or when so-what flags fcf_bridge_needed because no filing/company figure exists. Never leave divergent Yahoo TTM as policy.

tasks.title: Rotate CURSOR_API_KEY after suspected exposure
tasks.summary: If Cursor API misuse or GitHub secret exposure is suspected: revoke the key in the Cursor dashboard, set a new GitHub Actions secret (and any Cloud/cron copies), review odd workflow_run jobs, and confirm main workflow files were not planted. Prefer main branch protection so a stolen GITHUB_TOKEN cannot push exfil workflows.

tasks.title: Sync valid Cursor API key into GitHub Actions secrets
tasks.summary: When ftse-verify-key --key-source legacy fails but --key-source v2 succeeds (or GHA agent jobs 401): copy the valid User API key into GitHub Actions secrets CURSOR_API_KEY_V2 and CURSOR_API_KEY. Workflows prefer V2 via secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY_V2 || secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY. Cloud secrets alone do not feed Actions.

tasks.title: Review cycle-end Cursor surplus and provisional weekly-ops bump
tasks.summary: Near plan refresh day: ftse-library cycle-surplus assess with declared unused Ultra fraction, apply a 25% transfer into weekly_ops_cap only, then next cycle run review and --keep or --revert. 15% of listed plan credit / week is a warning on estimated weekly_ops USD, not a hard cap. Do not raise rememo daily caps, research_all_graduated, or offline memo density from leftover credit.

tasks.title: Review euro_depth filing/memo parity vs FTSE
tasks.summary: Check whether euro_depth buy-tier has usable euro_filings bodies and memo quality approaching FTSE; only then flip phase1_require_ai_beat_rules back on or promote to weekday Phase 3.

tasks.title: Horizon scan + deferred fragments
tasks.summary: First Sunday 11:00 UTC: weeder applies deterministic near-dup / already-an-idea DROPs; read horizon scan; triage remaining open fragments and deferred ideas. apply_fragments stays off unless you reviewed the markdown.

tasks.title: Follow unified ops review cadence
tasks.summary: Use the weekly → monthly → quarterly sequence in ops-review-cadence.md (analysis review, horizon scan, deferred ideas) rather than ad-hoc review order.

tasks.title: Deferred ideas review pass
tasks.summary: Review deferred-review.md; move items via ftse-defer status (done / drop / promote).

hor-20260811-02: Hold ai_judgment and rules knobs fixed for one epoch — accumulate ≥2 epoch marks and ≥1 epoch trade before any human decision-review apply; isolates cost/concentration effects of 2026-08-11 knob chang

hor-20260811-03: Buffered-hold counterfactual on rules/ai_judgment — replay last 7d exits (3 full_exits each track, exit_streak=1 on HIK.L/ITV.L/FGP.L) with exit_confirm_screens 1 vs 2; quantifies churn-guard sensitiv

hor-20260811-04: Extend archive near-miss to held-ticker episodes — rerun hold_recovery/swap_rotation on names that appeared in rebalance_log with buy-tier history (not only below-buy-tier gate); closes gap that 7/7 s

hor-20260811-05: Epoch-zero datum dashboard slice — surface per-track epoch NAV, post-apply trade count, and benchmark span availability (all tracks currently "Insufficient epoch marks"); makes stage 2b underperforman

tasks.title: Triage analysis_tasks experiments
tasks.summary: Persist/publish/apply high system_gaps flags auto-queue as eng-sgap-* (no agent dispatch). Triage remaining proposed produce/learning-clock flags with ftse-analysis-review promote. Phase B rememo is body-lag slim — do not promote thin_memo_counted_as_coverage as rememo-eligibility widening; thicken filings then existing rememo_reason. Scoring candidates remain eng-20260903-02 / eng-20260903-03 (observe-only; no assign_signal() edits). Keep paper_knobs and offline_sim manual; do not revive cancelled N58/N59 knob counterfactuals.

tasks.title: Exclusion ladder shadow spawn gate
tasks.summary: If exclusion_ladder_replay readiness.ready_for_shadow_spawn is true, run ftse-exclusion-ladder-replay spawn-shadow manually. Never auto-spawn.

tasks.title: Review in-portfolio hypothesis integrity when losers breach tolerance
tasks.summary: If learning_tracks_hypothesis_integrity shows within_tolerance=false, broken_loser_count>0, or selection_feedback_flags, read track hypothesis_integrity.md. Prefer thesis-broken rotation over crude stops; do not auto-apply exit knobs.

tasks.title: Start Phase C freeze writer only when readiness is READY
tasks.summary: Before building or enabling the PIT autopsy freeze writer, confirm phase_c_readiness.json (or ftse-phase-c-readiness exit 0) is READY. Do not start Phase C on vibes or with --force-phase-b-done alone — that override does not invent rebalance history or feature coverage.

tasks.title: Review dual-path sleeve episodes when tag cohorts mature
tasks.summary: When learning_tracks_sleeve_episodes readiness.ready_for_sleeve_timing_analysis is true (≥15 closed per on_book/off_book/never_funded), review stratified sleeve timing. Do not mix never_funded marks into NAV vs ^FTSE. Do not back-label historical NAV as sleeve evidence.

tasks.title: Triage paper-learning and learning-director tasks
tasks.summary: These queues have no promote CLI. Remaining: watch u4 (ldr-20260823-02) and exit-shadow (ana-20260728-04); leave L111 replay as continue. Buffered-hold and IMB.L audits are done. Do not reopen duplicate human-ack wrappers. Prefer the engineering queue for the two scoring tasks.

tasks.title: Clear engineering parked backlog when dispatch pauses
tasks.summary: Hourly recover-queue self-heals first (cancel resolved/superseded gap-closure parks; unpark healed preflight_clash) before the cap-8 pause/email. When the warning still fires, triage remaining oldest parks via `ftse-engineering list-parked` (merge, cancel, or unpark). Queue auto-resumes when count drops below 7 and 30 minutes have elapsed since the last clearing action. Separate from project-traffic pause (stuck CI/conflict PRs).

analysis.headline: 1 attention-parked eng tasks
bullets: eng-20260924-02: Hunt fetchable IR source for parked euro_stoxx50 leftover ADYEN.AS

tasks.title: Review open ingest deviations and reprocess if needed
tasks.summary: When Automation → Ingest deviations shows open rows, follow observe-only signal_triage (leftover → dismiss, buy → park/hunter via dismiss, strong_buy → approve pin). Approve writes a 7-day intensive pin; dismiss closes 7 days. Do not auto-replace IR URLs.

analysis.headline: Ingest deviations · 1 open
bullets: MC.PA: blocker_no_improve — MC.PA hit the weekday ticker cap with no coverage gain and 1 indexed-without-body row(s). Pin intensive or fix sources.

tasks.title: Watch shard epoch-0 and near-miss before forking AI
tasks.summary: Admitted markets (sp500, asx200) run a frozen buy-tier-level book plus equal-support. The AI-fork watch cut is buy-not-now (timing wait on buy-tier) and hold-near-buy (hold at or above 0.28). not-buy-tier and never-buy-tier are census/persistence inventories, not the sample. Do not spawn shard AI-judgment or decision-review --apply until epoch-0 and the tight groups have marks. Knob apply is the same gate as forking the AI track. FTSE remains the data lead.

automated_tasks.title: Spot-check learning tracks after paper-auto
automated_tasks.summary: ops-monitor (13:15 catch-up) checks post-settle last_run, decision-review coverage of AI judgment vs rules, competing calibrated shadows, and Suite B buy_tier_level. Workflow freshness covers CI acted. Excess vs ^FTSE comparison stays Sunday — do not promote on weekday marks.

automated_tasks.title: Paper-auto + decision-review apply
automated_tasks.summary: Runs all learning tracks (including competing calibrated shadows and the Suite B buy_tier_level cohort), refreshes overlay, appends rebalance_log, applies clamped knobs when history is thick. Shadows and the cohort lab are observe-only (no --apply); endurance ledger refreshes after review.

automated_tasks.title: GHA secret hygiene scan
automated_tasks.summary: Daily Actions scan for public-repo workflow_run secret-exposure patterns. Skips when no main merges / workflow touches in the last 36h; always runs on PRs that change workflows. Failures open a supervised engineering task.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted epoch-0 local-open marks
automated_tasks.summary: library-epoch0-weekday.yml marks admitted buy_tier_level books after ASX / EU / US open+settle. Session gate skips pre-settle and already-marked local days. No AI track, no knob apply, not FTSE paper-auto at 08:25 UTC. Census refresh writes equal_support_status.json.

automated_tasks.title: Epoch-0 weekday local-open crons (admit + sync)
automated_tasks.summary: On learning admit and on euro-ingest-dispatch --sync-cron, upsert timezone-bucket cron-job.org jobs (asx/euro/us-edt/us-est) for admitted markets. Ingest/sprint/maintenance workflows pass CRONJOB_API_KEY + WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT. Soft-skips when secrets are missing. Do not attach these to FTSE weekday_paper at 08:25 UTC.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted-market weekday rememo
automated_tasks.summary: After library ingest maintenance, rememo up to 3 body-lag buy-tier names per admitted/epoch-0 market (same cap as FTSE). Catch-up to 5 when that market's backlog exceeds 15. Once per weekday. No AI / no Sunday dump / no 21-market spray.

automated_tasks.title: Project traffic pause / unstick / EOD digest
automated_tasks.summary: Weekday project-traffic (and ops-monitor) classifies stuck cursor/* PRs, pauses new engineering-agent dispatch, comments for CI/conflict fixes (appending pr_fix_occasions.json with failure reasons), may dispatch conflict-resolve for eng branches, stops Composer reburn / Cursor fail-loop automation waste (park burning tasks + pause), and writes a grounded EOD digest that lists today's eng merges (including independently verified ingest_narrow / scoring_narrow / compile_cap_drain auto-merges) plus common PR-fix failure reasons. Automation → Queue & hunter monitor shows today/yesterday merge counts, a 14-day auto vs manual merge bar chart, and PR-fix intervention tallies. Spot-check digest trajectory and the merges-today list when pause is active, auto-merges land, or a cohesion_bypass task still needed human merge because the actual diff stayed over the path cap.

automated_tasks.title: Confirm buy-tier level cohort first fill
automated_tasks.summary: ops-monitor fails when buy_tier_level acted with an empty book. Knobs stay frozen. Do not treat first-fill NAV as promotion truth (Sunday gates).

automated_tasks.title: FTSE buy-tier level DCA realism (£500/mo)
automated_tasks.summary: Paper-auto runs buy_tier_level_dca (same level-book policy, monthly_deposit=500, cold-start capital epoch). Overlays FTSE Overview held-vs-market as branch series with deposit-matched ^FTSE. Not a promotion gate; recycling buy_tier_level stays the primary held line.

automated_tasks.title: Dual-path sleeve episodes (observe-only)
automated_tasks.summary: Paper-auto opens/updates widest sleeve episodes (near-buy hold@≥0.28 or buy-tier → grace-end+~1m / fallback leave-wide×confirms+~1m) with capital_status tags (on_book / off_book / never_funded). Does not change allocation or NAV scoreboard. Manual: ftse-sleeve-episodes.

automated_tasks.title: Phase C readiness assessment (observe-only)
automated_tasks.summary: Sunday analysis-review runs ftse-phase-c-readiness and writes docs/data/phase_c_readiness.json. Checks Phase B slim evidence, ≥8 weeks AI-judgment rebalance_log with buy-tier/candidates, and non-trivial feature coverage. Does not fail the Sunday job on NOT READY.

automated_tasks.title: Watch ingest capacity as more markets come on stream
automated_tasks.summary: Spare sprint auto-advance down the queue is correct. Crowded maintenance defaults to 2 markets/slot (L454); ftse-library maintenance-capacity-review steps width or proposes matrix from samples. Confirm library-ingest-maintenance still finishes inside 120 minutes; the 62-name deepen cap is usually not binding.

automated_tasks.title: Admitted-market epoch-0 shard (buy-tier-level + near-miss)
automated_tasks.summary: Ladder stamps equal-support timing (and near-miss / exclusion archives) before ftse-library shard-epoch0 so skip_timing_wait can drop timing_signal=wait from new buys. Wait names stay on the observe-only near_miss_watch.json sample. Sunday prefers first-time memos and rememos the focus book only; admitted body-lag rememo and local-open marks are weekday jobs. No AI-judgment track and no knob apply.

automated_tasks.title: Full-period knob calibrate + shadow bootstrap
automated_tasks.summary: analysis-review.yml runs ftse-knob-calibrate with full_period_retrospective, writes bootstrap_priors, spawns competing shadows, PIT warm-starts them from parent rebalance_log (forward-only endurance zero datum), and refreshes endurance.

automated_tasks.title: Re-import euro ingest cron slots after cadence change
automated_tasks.summary: On main merge of import_cron_jobs.py / epoch0 slots / euro+library ingest workflow schedules, import-ingest-crons.yml re-imports Mon–Sat peak + daily off-peak slots (and epoch-0 buckets) on cron-job.org. Soft-skips when CRONJOB_API_KEY or WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT is missing. Manual re-import only if the workflow was deleted or secrets were absent.

automated_tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title FTSE ops monitor catch-up). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job ops-monitor-catchup. GitHub schedule is backup. Verify with gh run list --workflow=ops-monitor.yml.

automated_tasks.title: Register project-traffic weekday crons
automated_tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (midday 12:30 + EOD 17:30 UTC weekdays). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job project-traffic-midday --job project-traffic-eod. GitHub schedule is backup only.

automated_tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title GHA secret hygiene). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job gha-secret-hygiene. GitHub schedule is backup. Verify with gh run list --workflow=gha-secret-hygiene.yml.

automated_tasks.title: Register dashboard-bridge weekday every-10m cron on cron-job.org
automated_tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title FTSE dashboard bridge weekday every 10m, jobId 8513740). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job dashboard-bridge.
